svg.title: Key and Secret Management — built it, not described
svg.desc: Concentric growth rings expanding from a single small warm origin at the lower centre. The innermost rings are drawn as faint dotted lines and each successive ring becomes more solid. Seven amber marks show where a pressure forced the next layer of growth, and the scar each one left stays visible in every ring after it. The outermost rings run off all four edges of the cover.
